verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions is explicitly documented as GitHub Actions-compatible, allowing developers to write YAML workflows and reuse existing Actions plugins from the community (gitea-docs-2). However, there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of this reuse working smoothly, no detail on marketplace or discovery mechanisms, and community evidence (gitea-comm-4, gitea-comm-7) suggests many users historically relied on external CI (Drone) rather than native Actions, indicating the ecosystem/ergonomics may be thinner than GitHub's. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of reusing third-party Actions in Gitea, details on a marketplace or discovery tooling for community actions, evidence of compatibility edge cases or limitations.
